entities.name: Nnr NAD(P)HX repair enzyme
observations: 519-aa query matches reviewed Nnr homolog Q2RGI2 at 51.1% identity, 99.4% query coverage, E=1.74e-166; function assignment is homology-supported.
Nnr homolog annotations support (6R)/(6S)-NADHX and NADPHX epimerization (EC 5.1.99.6) and ADP-dependent dehydration of (6S)-NAD(P)HX to NAD(P)H/NADPH (EC 4.2.1.136).
Reviewed homolog annotation reports one bound K+ per subunit; query-specific cofactor binding is inferred, not directly established.

entities.name: NAD(P)HX dehydration
observations: Reference reaction: (6S)-NADHX + ADP = AMP + phosphate + NADH + H+; corresponding NADPHX reaction yields NADPH. Rhea RHEA:32223 and RHEA:32235.

entities.name: NAD(P)HX epimerization
observations: Reference reaction: (6R)-NADHX = (6S)-NADHX and analogous NADPHX epimerization. Rhea RHEA:32215 and RHEA:32227.
